title: CommunityPasteModerateResult
description: community.paste-moderate-result@1: answers of the staff paste routes on OpenVibe.Community. POST /api/pastes/bulk → { done, skipped }; POST /api/pastes/:slug/censor → { paste } (the paste with its new image); DELETE /api/pastes/:slug/comments/:id → { message: 'Comment deleted' }. Each action is written to the moderation audit log (community.moderation.action).
